items.summary: The Illinois Commerce Commission approved base rate increases for WEC Energy's utility subsidiaries: $40.4 million (4.1%) for Peoples Gas Light and Coke Company and $1.9 million (1.8%) for North Shore Gas Company, effective no later than December 18, 2026. The ICC approved a 9.48% authorized return on equity and disallowed $44.82 million of PGL's 2026 forecasted capital costs related to its Pipeline Replacement Program, though WEC said it does not anticipate an impairment charge other than approximately $1.7 million.
items.title: WEC Energy subsidiaries receive $42.3 million base rate increase from Illinois regulator

items.summary: Energy Transfer LP completed an underwritten public offering of $2.7B in senior notes across three tranches on November 20, 2026: $900M of 5.450% notes due 2032, $900M of 5.900% notes due 2037, and $900M of 6.550% notes due 2057. The notes were issued under a supplemental indenture with U.S. Bank Trust Company, National Association, as trustee.
items.title: Energy Transfer LP completes $2.7B senior notes offering in three tranches

items.summary: George A. Scangos, Ph.D., a member of Agilent Technologies' Board of Directors, notified the company on November 16, 2026, of his decision to retire from the Board effective December 1, 2026. The Board decided to reduce its size from 11 to 10 members following Dr. Scangos's retirement. The company stated his departure was not due to any disagreement with the Company or the Board.
items.title: Agilent Technologies director George Scangos retires from board

items.summary: Baker Hughes completed its acquisition of Chart Industries on July 16, 2026 for $210.00 per share in cash, pursuant to an Agreement and Plan of Merger dated July 28, 2025. Chart Industries reported net income of $1.0M for the six months ended June 30, 2026 compared to $125.6M for the same period in 2025, with sales of $1,870.4M versus $2,083.8M year over year. Baker Hughes funded a $266.0M termination fee to Flowserve Corporation for Chart's previously announced merger with that company.
items.title: Baker Hughes completes Chart Industries acquisition on July 16, 2026

items.summary: The Federal Reserve announced that UCLA won the 23rd annual College Fed Challenge, a competition in which undergraduate students analyze economic conditions and formulate monetary policy recommendations. The competition included 141 schools from 34 states, the most in its history.
items.title: Federal Reserve announces College Fed Challenge winners

items.summary: The Federal Reserve Board released results from a survey of senior financial officers at banks conducted between September 18 and September 28, 2026, in collaboration with the Federal Reserve Bank of New York. The survey included responses from banks holding approximately three-fourths of total banking system reserve balances and gathered information about banks' reserve balance management strategies, balance sheet expectations, deposit balances, money market activity, and views on operations during weekends and holidays.
items.title: Federal Reserve releases Senior Financial Officer Survey on reserve balance management

items.summary: Worldwide employment by U.S. multinational enterprises rose 0.9% to 44.2 million workers in 2024 from 43.8 million in 2023, according to the Bureau of Economic Analysis. The figure includes U.S. parent companies and their majority-owned foreign affiliates.
items.title: U.S. multinational enterprises employed 44.2 million workers globally in 2024

items.summary: The Federal Reserve published the minutes from its Federal Open Market Committee meeting held on October 27-28, 2026. The minutes are released three weeks after the policy decision and reflect economic and financial conditions available to the Committee at the time of the meeting.
items.title: Federal Reserve releases October 2026 FOMC meeting minutes

items.summary: The outdoor recreation economy accounted for $704.2 billion, or 2.3 percent of current-dollar GDP in 2025. Across states, outdoor recreation's share of GDP ranged from 6.1 percent in Hawaii to 1.0 percent in the District of Columbia.
items.title: Bureau of Economic Analysis reports outdoor recreation at 2.3 percent of U.S. GDP in 2025

items.summary: Target Corporation reported third quarter net sales of $27.1 billion, up 7.1 percent from the year-ago period, with comparable sales growth of 5.6 percent. Diluted earnings per share reached $2.65 compared with $1.51 a year earlier, boosted by $0.50 per share from tariff refunds. The company raised full-year 2026 net sales guidance to around 6 percent growth and projects 2027 capital expenditures of $5 billion to $6 billion.
items.title: Target reports third quarter earnings with 7.1 percent sales growth

items.summary: AMETEK Inc signed underwriting agreements on November 16, 2026 to issue $500M of 5.550% Senior Notes due 2031, C$600M of 4.500% Senior Notes due 2032, and €1.5B of 4.150% and 4.450% Senior Notes due 2030 and 2034. The offerings are expected to close on November 20, 2026, with net proceeds estimated at approximately $494.1M from USD notes, C$592.8M from CAD notes and €1.49B from EUR notes. The company intends to use the proceeds to repay borrowings under its credit agreements and commercial paper obligations and for general corporate purposes.
items.title: AMETEK Inc enters underwriting agreements for $500M USD and foreign currency notes

items.summary: PT Freeport Indonesia, a 48.76%-owned subsidiary of Freeport-McMoRan Inc., priced $750 million aggregate principal amount of 6.90% senior notes due 2033. The notes are expected to settle on November 24, 2026, with proceeds to refinance existing indebtedness and for general corporate purposes.
items.title: Freeport-McMoRan subsidiary prices $750 million senior notes offering

items.summary: Restaurant Brands International announced the pricing of a $1 billion senior secured notes offering on November 17, 2026, comprising $500 million of 6.00% notes due 2031 and $500 million of 6.40% notes due 2036. The company said it expects to use the proceeds to repay a portion of outstanding borrowings under its term loan B facility and to pay related fees and expenses, with closing expected around November 24, 2026.
items.title: Restaurant Brands International prices $1B senior secured notes offering

items.summary: CSX Corporation entered into a new $1.2 billion five-year senior unsecured revolving credit agreement with JPMorgan Chase Bank as administrative agent on November 17, 2026. The agreement replaces a prior $1.2 billion credit facility dated February 28, 2023. As of the filing date, there were no outstanding borrowings under the new agreement.
items.title: CSX Corporation enters $1.2 billion five-year revolving credit agreement

items.summary: Ecolab announced an expansion of its One Ecolab initiative on November 17, 2026, anticipating total restructuring costs of $485 million ($378 million after tax) and special charges of $115 million ($90 million after tax) by the end of 2030. The restructuring plan aims to leverage digital technologies to realign functional work across countries into global centers of excellence, with costs primarily for severance related to team realignment.
items.title: Ecolab expands One Ecolab initiative with $485 million restructuring cost

items.summary: Old Dominion Freight Line entered into a five-year, $500.0 million senior unsecured revolving credit facility on November 17, 2026, amending its existing $400.0 million facility. The company may request an additional $250.0 million increase for a total facility size of up to $750.0 million, subject to lender approval.
items.title: Old Dominion Freight Line increases revolving credit facility to $500M

items.summary: Comfort Systems USA's board approved an amendment to increase its stock repurchase program to 1,000,000 shares authorized and remaining for repurchase by authorizing acquisition of up to 679,520 additional shares. The company repurchased 1,552,236 shares from January 1 through November 16, 2026 at an aggregate price of $1.9B, financed from ongoing cash flows and existing cash balances.
items.title: Comfort Systems USA increases stock repurchase program by 679,520 shares
